annotations.title: Windows Server and SQL Server end-of-support dates

description: Call this when a user asks whether their website is at risk from Windows Server 2012 end of life or another out-of-support Windows Server or SQL Server version. Returns Microsoft's end-of-support dates with a source link for each, plus the Extended Security Updates cutoff. `product` matches part of a product name, e.g. "2012" or "SQL"; omit it to return all products.

product.description: Optional. Matches part of a product name, e.g. "2012" or "SQL"; omit it to return all products.
